Phase 4 scope (see .agentic/specs/webapp-spec.md and .agentic/specs/webapp-roadmap.md Phase 4):

BACKEND (5 endpoints):
1. POST /api/users — register new user
2. DELETE /api/users/:name — revoke user
3. POST /api/users/:name/regenerate — regenerate token
4. POST /api/sync/push — push local changes to remote
5. POST /api/sync/pull — pull remote changes

FRONTEND:
6. User management UI (list users, register new user dialog, revoke with confirmation, regenerate token showing new token)
7. Sync controls in header (Push/Pull buttons, loading spinner, success/error feedback, last sync timestamp)

VALIDATION CRITERIA:
- Can register a new user via the UI
- Can revoke a user
- Can regenerate a token
- Push button syncs changes to remote
- Pull button fetches remote changes
- Sync status feedback is clear
